infoLinks.content:

  • Buses replace trains between Macarthur, Glenfield and Fairfield.

  • Sunday from 6.30am to 10.30am, buses replace Inner West trains between Ashfield and Central.

Services towards Bondi Junction will be diverting via Cleveland St, South Dowling St, Fitzroy St and Foveaux St.
 
Services towards Marrickville will be diverting via Albion St, Flinders St, South Dowling St and Cleveland St.
 
Use alternative stops further along Crown St or Baptist St. Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations.
